settings.voice.autoSend: Send automatically when I stop talking
settings.stage.follow: Camera follows her like a viewer in the room
settings.stage.follow.hint: MMD models only. Dragging or zooming the view pauses the follow; double-click the stage to resume it.
settings.stage.selfies: Now and then she sends a selfie from the stage
settings.stage.selfies.hint: At most twice a day between 10:00 and 21:30, three hours apart, once you have left her alone for half an hour, while the chat is open. The pictures are kept in your account.
chat.unreachable: Cannot reach the server; this turn did not finish. When you are back online, reload the chat to see what the server kept.
settings.stage.license: Use only models you are licensed to use.
settings.data.clearConfirm: Clear all local settings on this device?
settings.account.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and everything stored for it? This cannot be undone.
module.speakFirst: Speaks first when it is quiet
admin.backfill.result: Scanned {0} events: {1} rows planned, {2} inserted, {3} already present, {4} conflicting.
admin.backfill.confirm: Insert the missing render-trace rows now?
admin.gateway.help: Routing document as JSON. Keys are shown masked (…last four); leave a masked key as it is to keep it, or replace it with a full key.
admin.gateway.invalid: That is not a valid JSON object.
vision.attached: Image attached; it goes with your next message.
settings.vision.privacy: Nothing is captured until you share your screen or camera. Frames are scaled down and described by the vision model through the server; only the description is kept, as context for the chat.
settings.research.consent: Record research telemetry on this device
settings.research.hint: With your consent, how the companion's persona changes turn by turn is recorded in this browser only (no message text). Turning this off deletes what was recorded.
settings.research.cleared: Research data on this device deleted.
auth.serverInvalid: enter the server address as http(s)://host[:port]
admin.tools.help: Tools the companion can use while it answers. Providers: mcp-http (url, headers), mcp-stdio (command, args, env), homeassistant (url, token, domains), xiaomi (username, password, region), factorio (host, port, password, allowCommands). Secrets are shown masked; leave them as they are to keep them. allowAllUsers lets every account use the tools (otherwise administrators only).
chess.title: Chess with your companion
chess.engine: {0} (the helper engine chose this move; the companion did not give a legal one)
settings.stage.scene.name: Scene name
companion.intro: A fictional daily life, shared moments and your private collection.
companion.weather.enabled: Use real weather for the chosen city
companion.weather.hint: The chosen coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo, whose current conditions are modelled. No device location is read.
companion.relationship.hint: Warm interactions change affection. Being offline does not lower it. Quiet hours and requests to pause still apply.
companion.collection.hint: Import up to 32 private items, at most 2 MiB each. Add songs recorded with your own or an authorised voice. In chat: /life, /relationship, /photo selfie|snapshot|landscape, /sing title.
companion.name: Name / song title
companion.noPlaces: No matching city. Try another name.
companion.services.admin: Only an administrator can change service connections.
companion.services.hint: Save or change a connection at any time. Changes apply to subsequent requests. Empty or disabled services remain optional.
companion.services.local: This capability uses a local service.
companion.services.other: Not configured locally. Saving this section selects a local service for this capability.
companion.services.training: Folder settings do not load or train a model. A successful connection check does not verify the voice or singing quality. MOSAIC speech uses the voice loaded by its service; singing uses the configured voice identifier.
companion.services.saved: Settings saved. Subsequent requests will use them.
companion.services.reachable: Service reachable; audio quality not verified.
companion.location.label: City label
companion.timezone: Time zone (blank uses the shared server clock)
companion.location.hint: You can enter a location offline and change it later. A city label alone does not supply weather: choose a city result or enter both coordinates.
companion.location.clear: Clear location; use shared server clock
companion.sync.title: Web and QQ synchronization
companion.sync.hint: Both clients use the signed-in account’s selected character. For a QQ bot with a separate account, generate a one-use code and send /bind CODE in its private chat. The code expires in ten minutes. Unlink to revoke future access.
companion.sync.changed: Another client changed the profile. Your unsaved edits are kept; refresh before saving.
companion.sync.legacy: Some older items could not be copied. The device source is preserved.
companion.diary.title: Shared diary
companion.diary.hint: Send /diary save after a conversation to share that excerpt with linked QQ. It records what was said, not verified real-world events. Saved excerpts remain separate from chat history; forgetting one does not delete the original chat.
companion.diary.empty: No saved exchanges on this date.
companion.delivery.title: QQ delivery records
companion.delivery.hint: Records cover ordinary QQ replies, proactive messages, due reminders and explicit media commands. Platform acceptance does not prove that a person received or read a message. Failed or unknown attempts are not resent automatically. Older completed records are removed as the recent history rolls forward; original chats remain.
companion.delivery.empty: No recorded attempts for this character.
companion.delivery.rejected: A part was rejected by the platform
